for assets to be disposed of by sale, primarily related to sales offices and warehousing and distribution facilities

million contractual obligations and other charges represent costs associated with the termination of various
supplier contracts as well as other incidental costs. The following table provides a rollforward of the remaining liabilities, included within accrued expenses
